* [[Pope]] [[Pope John Paul II|John Paul II]] [[Death and funeral of Pope John Paul II|dies]] at 9:37 p.m. Vatican time ([[Central European Summer Time|CEST]]) at the age of 84, thus ending the third longest papacy in history and the beginning of a ''[[Sede vacante]]'' period. [[n:Pope John Paul II dies|(Wikinews)]]
* [[2005 Sumatran earthquake|Sumatran earthquake]]: Nine [[Australian Defence Force]] personnel are missing, presumed dead, after a [[Westland Sea King|Sea King helicopter]] crash on the [[Indonesia]]n island of [[Nias]]. Two personnel survive.  [[n:RAN Sea King crashes in Nias killing all nine onboard|(Wikinews)]]
* Scientists at the [[California Institute of Technology]] devise a method to weigh the smallest mass ever, a cluster of [[xenon]] atoms weighing a few [[zeptogram]]s, or billionths of a trillionth of a gram. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/science/nature/4394947.stm (BBC)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20051124201305/http://www.aip.org/pnu/2005/split/725-1.html (AIP Bulletin)]
* [[Riccardo Muti]] resigns as [[music director]] of [[La Scala]] [[opera house]], [[Milan]] after 18 years, following a vote of no-confidence by 700 orchestra members and staff last month. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/entertainment/arts/4403819.stm (BBC)]
* In [[France]], radical [[wine]] producers attack the offices of [[agriculture]] ministries in [[Montpellier]] and [[Carcassonne]] with [[dynamite]]. A group calling itself ''[[Comité Régional d'Action Viticole]]'' (Crav) takes responsibility.[https://web.archive.org/web/20060111005534/http://www.couponmountain.ca/index.html (BBC)] [http://news.wine.co.za/News/News.aspx?NEWSID=6764&Source=HomePage (WineNews, SA)]{{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} [http://news.independent.co.uk/europe/story.jsp?story=625568 (Independent)]{{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}
* In [[Nepal]], former prime minister [[Girija Prasad Koirala]] is released from [[house arrest]] and demands the return to [[democracy]]. [http://www.newkerala.com/news-daily/news/features.php?action=fullnews&id=93291 (New Kerala)] [http://www.telegraphindia.com/1050403/asp/nation/story_4567700.asp (Telegraph, India)] [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/south_asia/4404029.stm (BBC)]
* [[Newcastle United]] teammates [[Kieron Dyer]] and [[Lee Bowyer]] are sent off for fighting each other in a 3-0 home defeat to [[Premier League|EPL]] rivals [[Aston Villa]] at [[St James' Park|St. James' Park]] [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2005/apr/03/match.sport5 (The Guardian)]
